messages:
devon: Heads-up — during the key-rotation dry run on staging we saw a sustained decrypt retry loop from the KMS client for ~90s. Not full outage but high latency and retries piled up. Logs attached below.

maria: Ugh, thanks. Do you have the logs/trace id? Was this AWS KMS or GCP KMS?

devon: AWS KMS in us-west-2. Trace: trace_id=stg-rot-2026-03-XX-42. Snippet:```WARN kms-client: decrypt failed, error=ThrottlingException, retry_count=3, backoff=200ms
WARN kms-client: decrypt failed, error=ThrottlingException, retry_count=4, backoff=400ms
INFO kms-client: decrypt succeeded, latency=1024ms, key_id=alias/redwood/staging/envelope```

samir: That latency jump (1s) after several throttles explains why our request queue backed up. Any envelope-cache hits?

devon: Cache hit rate dropped from 95% to ~40% during the window. We probably exhausted KMS quota for a short burst from rotation traffic + CI.

jena: Do we have RBAC or service principal churn that could've caused extra KMS requests? Rotation usually only calls the CMK a few times.

maria: We triggered parallel rotations across a few replicas to test rollout speed — that doubled decrypt calls for a short period. Bad combo with CI load.

samir: Action item: add a coordination lock for rotation so we don't hit KMS in parallel. Also add stricter client-side circuit breaker and exponential backoff cap.

devon: Agreed. Also proposing a short-lived local envelope-key caching layer per instance with TTL and LRU so decrypts avoid KMS for repeated prefixes. We already have prefix caching but TTLs are low.

jena: Can we update the KMS client to emit metrics for throttles (4xx KMS errors), average latency, and retry_count? We need alerting on sustained throttles > 30s.

maria: +1. Also audit log note: during rotation we should record a rotate-request id in our app logs so we can correlate to KMS spikes.

devon: Will open a PR: 1) rotation coordination (leader elect or lock in Redis), 2) cache TTL bump to 5m for staging/dev with safety guard, 3) circuit breaker + backoff jitter.

ops-bot: Reminder: created incident runbook task #924 - "KMS rotation backpressure" assigned to @devon. ETA for mitigation PR?

devon: I'll aim for a draft by EOD. We should also run the rotation test again behind a damper (stagger replicas).

samir: Long term: evaluate multi-region key usage and KMS rate quotas, and request increased throttle limits for critical CMKs. Also consider envelope key signing to reduce KMS verify calls.

jena: For compliance, ensure all rotation events are flushed to audit log and retained for 12 months.

maria: Thanks team. Small near-miss but good catch. After PR and one more staged run, we can mark this "mitigated" and follow up with a short postmortem note. :thumbsup:
